$comment: Route table: intent -> tier -> model -> permission. Seeded defaults; the SpacetimeDB route_rule table overrides these once connected. margin_bp is basis points over provider cost (0 = pass-through). Tier kind: chat (answers the user), decisions (Jev: typed decisions only, used for routing and checks), tagger (chips JSON). allowed_models is the per-request `model` allowlist for chat tiers.

fast.note: Fast chat tier. Set 2026-09-28 after openrouter/auto resolved to a reasoning model with ~2.5s to first token; awaiting Justin's confirmation.

careful.note: Same as fast until per-tier models are confirmed.

editor.note: Edits the interface through the op tools. Escalates to Sonnet 5.5 when Jev is unsure the request is an edit (confidence < 0.6), when the box is large, or for the one retry after rejected ops.

jev.note: TypeSafe Jev via the Decisions API. Typed decisions only (choice / noul / score), never prose. Routes intents and answers yes/no checks. $0.042 per million input tokens, output free. Override with OPENROUTER_JEV_MODEL.

tagger.note: Chips as JSON on keystroke pause when the dev toggle is on. $0.10/$0.40 per million. Not Haiku (10x the price).

image.note: Skin images (pass 5). Cheapest image-output model on OpenRouter by listed image-token price on 2026-09-29, but a live call cost $0.0417 for one image, more than the 3¢ refine cap, so the image path only runs if the cap is raised.

vision.note: Describes skin variants (images in, JSON out) before Jev scores them.

escalation.$comment: When the editor tier starts on the escalation model.

refine.$comment: refine() best-of-3 loop for skins. Stops at target_score, after patience rounds without a better best, at max_rounds, when cap_micro is spent, or on Stop. estimate_micro is per variant (generate + score) and keeps the loop under the cap before it spends. image_generate measured 2026-09-29: openai/gpt-5-image-mini cost 41,709 micro-dollars for one image, over the cap, so plans that pick it fall back to the next affordable path.
